description: This file implements a QR Code generator library in JavaScript, including classes for QR code creation, segments, error correction, and rendering methods.

classes.name: QrCode
classes.description: Represents an immutable QR code matrix with methods for creation, rendering, and analysis.

classes.name: QrSegment
classes.description: Represents a segment of data to be encoded in a QR code, with factory methods for different encoding modes.

classes.name: Ecc
classes.description: Enumeration for error correction levels in QR codes.

classes.name: Mode
classes.description: Represents the mode of a QR code data segment (numeric, alphanumeric, byte, kanji, ECI).

methods.name: encodeText
methods.description: Encodes a Unicode string into a QR code with specified error correction level.

methods.name: encodeBinary
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a QR code with specified error correction level.

methods.name: encodeSegments
methods.description: Encodes multiple data segments with specified parameters, choosing minimal version.

methods.name: getAlignmentPatternPositions
methods.description: Returns positions for alignment patterns for a given QR code version.

methods.name: getNumRawDataModules
methods.description: Calculates total data modules available for a given QR code version.

methods.name: getNumDataCodewords
methods.description: Calculates number of data codewords for a given version and error correction level.
